ATX 3.0 & PCIe Gen 5.0 Ready
Toughpower GF A3 Gold
650W / 750W / 850W / 1050W / 1200W
Power Up the Next Generation Hardware
To fully support next-gen hardware, Toughpower GF A3 Gold Series
(650W/750W/850W/1050W/1200W) is designed to meet ATX 3.0 standards, including a PCIe Gen
5.0 12VHPWR connector. The GF A3 Gold series delivers 80 PLUS Gold efficiency, it also
offers stability, durability, and reliability.
Fully Compatible with Intel ATX 3.0 Standards
Toughpower GF A3 Gold series is fully compatible with Intel ATX
3.0 Specifications which supports up to 200% power excursion, reaches 60% low load
efficiency and complies with required power supply timing standards.

Toughpower GF A3 Gold series comes with a 16pin connector to

GPUs.
The wattage marked on the 12VHPWR’s connector is the recommended wattage. (Ref. Intel

The native 16 PIN (12VHPWR) PCIe connector of the GF A3 1050W can deliver up to 600W for
